Your merged S6 data have a lot more unmapped reads (9719402) than S6_l1 and S6_l2. This resulted in much less reads assigned in S6 compared to S6_l1 and S6_l2. You will need to take a close look at what caused this difference in mapping. Which aligner did you use for mapping?

Best,
Wei
